test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

It is beyond my cognative capacity to solve the mathematical problems.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (2) i.e. "**cognative".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence is cognative.
 
• The CORRECT spelling is Cognitive (संज्ञानात्मक) - Related to thinking or the process of thought.
 
 
• **Example**: His cognitive skills make him successful in his life.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is cognative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Problems** (समस्याएं) - Difficult situations that need to be solved.
 
• **Mathematical **(गणितीय) - Pertaining to mathematics, or the use of numbers and calculations.
 
• **Capacity **(क्षमता) - The ability or power to do something.
